service.method: SELECT PROCESS_ID ,METHOD ,SERVICE_CLASS ,DESCRIPTION ,'Y' SAVED FROM SFRWK WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND PROCESS_ID = ${PROCESS_ID} AND ( 1=1 AND upper(METHOD) like '%' + upper($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' OR upper(DESCRIPTION) like '%' + upper($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' )

INSERT INTO #DB_OWNER#SFRWK ( HOUSE_CODE, PROCESS_ID, METHOD, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, USER_ID, URL, SERVICE_CLASS, VERSION, USE_FLAG, DESCRIPTION, AUTHO_OBJECT_CODE, FIELD_CODE, START_DATE, END_DATE, AUTHO_APPLY_FLAG, DEL_FLAG, ACC_DATE ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${PROCESS_ID}, ${METHOD}, ${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}, ${session.ID}, 'sepoaserviceclasses', ${SERVICE_CLASS}, '1.0.0', 'Y', ${DESCRIPTION}, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'N', 'N', NULL )
